hypotheses.reasoning: Migration 0124_add_region_id on ingest-api ran in 3 steps against events-db. Step 1 renamed events.region_id -> region_id_old and committed, but step 2 failed with a lock timeout (#1730). The DDL is non-transactional, so step 1 was never rolled back, leaving the events table without region_id. From 10:18:33 onward, events-db rejects every query that references region_id (#1876, #1918, #2064, #2129), and ingest-api fails its event queries with 'Unknown column region_id' (#1956, #2123, #2384, #2553). Those failures surface at ingest-gateway as POST /v1/events 500s (#1866, #2053, #2092, #2266, #2343, #2411, #2608), which is the paged alert. The 500s are a downstream symptom; the half-applied migration is the origin. Note that the enrichment, event-processor and index-worker lines show no errors, and the ingest path was healthy until the migration step ran at ~10:17.

Secondary, unrelated issue. catalog-db ran out of disk (95% then 99%, then 'could not extend file: No space left on device'), which breaks search-api product writes and produces the web-bff /search 500s. It does not touch POST /v1/events, so it is not the cause of the ingest-gateway alert, though it needs its own remediation. The report-cron ModuleNotFoundError for pandas (#1803 onward) is a separate bad deploy of report-cron:2026.10.2 and is also unrelated to the alert.

verdict.recommendedAction: Immediately repair events-db schema: restore the region_id column (rename events.region_id_old back to region_id, or re-add it with the correct definition and backfill) and confirm the migration state so 0124 can be re-run safely. Then verify POST /v1/events returns 200 on ingest-gateway. Before re-running the migration, check the lock holder on events, since step 2 hit a lock timeout. Make future DDL migrations transactional or add a compensating rollback. Separately, free disk on catalog-db (WAL/binlog growth ~531-833MB/h) to stop the search-api write failures, and fix the report-cron:2026.10.2 image, which is missing pandas.
